nf0997c8a59.headline: Farmers fear tariffs could cost them one of their biggest markets in China
nf0997c8a59.summary: Farmers in Nebraska fear new tariffs could cost them one of their biggest markets in China, after hoping for at least break-even results this year.
nf0997c8a59.why: China is a major buyer of US farm exports such as soybeans, so tariffs can sharply reduce farm incomes and prices.

n938b0605cb.headline: Opec+ stuns oil market with policy shift to drive down price
n938b0605cb.summary: OPEC+ has made a policy shift that surprised the oil market and is aimed at driving prices down. The Trump administration has promised to renew its maximum pressure campaign against Iran's exports.
n938b0605cb.why: OPEC+ is a producer group that sets output policy for much of the world's crude supply, so its decisions strongly influence Brent and WTI prices.
n938b0605cb.why_moved: OPEC+ shifted policy in a way that surprised the market and is aimed at lowering prices. Renewed U.S. pressure on Iran's exports adds to supply-side uncertainty.

ne5ccba857f.headline: ECB's Schnabel says 'dramatic surge' in uncertainty may get worse
ne5ccba857f.summary: ECB board member Isabel Schnabel said a dramatic surge in uncertainty has exacerbated the euro zone's structural headwinds. The uncertainty may get worse following US trade tariffs.
ne5ccba857f.why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the euro area, and its officials' views shape expectations for rates and the euro.

nd444d3845a.headline: Relief at the pump?: Kenya renews Gulf oil import deal at lower costs
nd444d3845a.summary: Kenya has renewed its oil import deal with Gulf suppliers at lower costs, a revised agreement that could ease fuel prices at the pump.
nd444d3845a.why: Kenya imports most of its refined fuel, so supply contract terms feed directly into domestic fuel prices.

n141bc7aa8e.headline: Tax reform bills: Extricating Nigeria from economic cesspit
n141bc7aa8e.summary: Nigerian commentary follows the tax reform bills before the National Assembly, framed as a route to fixing the country's economic problems. The description is brief and gives few specifics.
n141bc7aa8e.why: Nigeria is Africa's largest economy, and changes to its tax regime affect government revenue, the naira, and investor confidence in its frontier-market assets.

n8dc1fb0740.headline: Impact of Trump
n8dc1fb0740.summary: Slovak Central Bank Governor Peter Kažimír said 25% US tariffs on EU goods and services would negatively affect economic growth and drive up prices.
n8dc1fb0740.why: The central bank sets monetary policy for Slovakia, and its assessments guide expectations for inflation and growth in the euro-area economy.

n42c55698f6.headline: India, UAE to build strategic energy hub in Sri Lanka’s Trincomalee
n42c55698f6.summary: India, the UAE and Sri Lanka are collaborating on an energy hub in Trincomalee, a move that boosts New Delhi's competition with China in the region.
n42c55698f6.why: Energy hubs handle fuel storage and trade routes, and projects like this shape regional energy security and investment flows in the Indian Ocean.

n7166e640c7.headline: Tinubu’s tax reforms take shape - experts applaud FIRS chairman
n7166e640c7.summary: Nigeria's House of Representatives has passed a series of Tax Reform Bills aimed at overhauling the country's tax system, which experts say will improve efficiency and transparency.
n7166e640c7.why: Tax policy shapes government revenue, business costs and investor confidence in Africa's largest economy by population.

n138da0448d.headline: Iran's currency falls to record low against the dollar
n138da0448d.summary: Iran's rial traded at a record low against the US dollar on Saturday, costing over 1 million rials per dollar as the market reopened after a long holiday.
n138da0448d.why: The rial's value against the dollar reflects Iran's economic pressures, and sharp currency falls raise import prices and inflation for households.
n138da0448d.why_moved: The rial hit a record low as trading resumed after a holiday, with tensions between Tehran and Washington expected to push it lower.

nfd557613ec.headline: Govt must keep national interests foremost while formulating strategy on US tariffs: Congress - OrissaPOST
nfd557613ec.summary: Senior Congress leader Anand Sharma called US tariffs unfortunate and unilateral. He asked the government to consult political parties and stakeholders while formulating its response.
nfd557613ec.why: US tariffs on Indian exports affect trade flows, manufacturing sectors and the currency outlook for India's economy.

source.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

sources.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

n8291153bd8.headline: High-tech sector remains Israel’s economic engine despite war, says top economist
n8291153bd8.summary: A top Israeli economist said Israel has more people employed in the high-tech sector than any other country. He made the remarks despite the ongoing war.
n8291153bd8.why: Israel's high-tech sector, including its venture-backed startups, is a major source of exports, employment and foreign investment.

ndb3850ab8b.headline: US-Iran confrontation: Geopolitical crisis with far-reaching consequences
ndb3850ab8b.summary: Amid growing US pressure, tensions with Iran are escalating, with President Donald Trump reviving first-term plans and seeking a firm, aggressive stance toward Tehran.
ndb3850ab8b.why: Confrontation involving Iran can affect Middle East oil supply risk and broader risk sentiment across global markets.

n0f5585bd08.headline: Warning on jobs and price rises as national insurance hike comes into effect
n0f5585bd08.summary: UKHospitality chief executive Kate Nicholls warned that workers and businesses will be affected as the national insurance increase comes into effect.
n0f5585bd08.why: Employer national insurance contributions are a payroll cost, so changes to them affect hiring, wage budgets and consumer prices across the UK economy.

nbde1f4561d.headline: Champagne loses its fizz as sales to UK fall to 25-year low with prices soaring
nbde1f4561d.summary: Champagne sales in the UK have fallen to a 25-year low, with prices up 25% in three years. Sales of cheaper alternatives such as prosecco are booming.
nbde1f4561d.why: Champagne is a premium drinks category, and shifts in consumer spending toward cheaper sparkling wines affect producers and retailers.

ne3ef6d2446.headline: Leverage tourism as economic defense against US tariffs: Minister
ne3ef6d2446.summary: Indonesia's tourism sector could serve as a national economic defence against external pressures from trade tariffs, a minister said. The comments reflect concern over US tariff measures.
ne3ef6d2446.why: Tourism brings foreign currency and service-sector jobs, so it can cushion an export slowdown. Investors watch such policy responses for signs of fiscal or sector support.

na09ac33a27.headline: Starmer pledges to ‘do everything necessary’ to protect UK amid tariffs fallout
na09ac33a27.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer pledged to do everything necessary to protect the UK amid tariff fallout. He said he would turbocharge plans to improve domestic competitiveness.
na09ac33a27.why: The UK government's response to tariffs shapes fiscal policy, trade relations and business confidence. Competitiveness measures can affect sectors exposed to trade.

n5dcd1aa159.headline: US tariffs raise US recession risks, threaten global economic outlook - Fitch
n5dcd1aa159.summary: Fitch estimates the tariff changes will raise the overall US effective tax rate on imports to about 25%, above its 18% 2025 assumption. It warns of higher US recession risks and a weaker global outlook.
n5dcd1aa159.why: Fitch is a major credit rating agency, and its macro forecasts influence views on sovereign credit and global growth.

n65e940c1b8.headline: India, UAE to develop Sri Lanka energy hub as Delhi competes with China for influence
n65e940c1b8.summary: India, the UAE and Sri Lanka signed a pact to develop an energy hub in Trincomalee during Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit. Delhi is competing with China for influence.
n65e940c1b8.why: Energy hubs and port infrastructure shape regional energy trade routes and investment flows, and the Indian Ocean is strategically important for oil shipping.

na9a7e14903.headline: UK employers struggling to fill roles say candidates are being too picky
na9a7e14903.summary: UK employers say they are struggling to fill roles because prospective candidates increasingly demand the ability to work from home. The comments highlight tight hiring conditions.
na9a7e14903.why: Labour availability and hiring terms affect wage pressure and productivity across the UK economy.

n48156c5c23.headline: Trump tariffs 'tough' but opportunity for Canada, says Carney
n48156c5c23.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney called US auto tariffs tough but also an enormous opportunity, speaking in Woodbridge, Ontario.
n48156c5c23.why: Canada's auto sector is closely integrated with US manufacturing, so US auto tariffs directly affect Canadian producers and trade.

n5c92ea4298.headline: Starmer pledges support for businesses hit by Trump tariffs
n5c92ea4298.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer pledged government support for British businesses facing disruption from US President Donald Trump's tariffs.
n5c92ea4298.why: Tariffs disrupt UK exporters and trade flows, making government support a factor for affected firms and sectors.

nf6b85a9683.headline: Govt must keep national interests foremost while formulating strategy on US tariffs: Congress
nf6b85a9683.summary: Senior Congress leader Anand Sharma criticised US tariffs as unilateral and urged the government to consult stakeholders and form a task force on trade impact.
nf6b85a9683.why: US tariffs affect India's exports and trade relations, so policy responses shape exporters and sectors exposed to US demand.

n491ff0838d.headline: Global markets nose-dive as Trump’s 10% tariff on UK products comes into effect
n491ff0838d.summary: Global markets sold off as Trump's 10% tariff on UK products came into effect. Prime Minister Keir Starmer is expected to spend the weekend speaking to foreign leaders about the import taxes.
n491ff0838d.why: The UK is a major trading economy, and US tariffs on its exports affect sterling-linked assets and sectors exposed to transatlantic trade.
n491ff0838d.why_moved: A new 10% US tariff on UK goods took effect, and the input reports global markets falling as a result.

nce6db84272.headline: How Trump’s tariffs are shaking up the cybersecurity sector
nce6db84272.summary: President Trump's tariff announcement sent US cybersecurity stocks into a sharp decline. Investors fear cyber spending cuts and the possible rise of cyber monocultures.
nce6db84272.why: Cybersecurity firms sell software and services to corporations and governments, so changes in enterprise and public spending affect their revenues.

n96b7b5f90c.headline: Experts urge caution over proposed sugary drink tax in Vietnam
n96b7b5f90c.summary: Experts discussed a proposed amendment to the Law on Special Consumption Tax for the beverage sector at a Hanoi roundtable hosted by the Vietnam Beer-Alcohol-Beverage Association.
n96b7b5f90c.why: Special consumption taxes change the pricing and volumes of beverage makers, and they are a common policy tool in Asian markets.

n92a97819c3.headline: Investors told to step up for Philippines energy transition
n92a97819c3.summary: Energy Secretary Raphael Lotilla is urging investors to take a leading role in driving the Philippines toward its energy transition goals, with government in a supporting role.
n92a97819c3.why: Energy transition spending requires private capital, and policy direction from the energy department shapes returns in power and renewables projects.

n8f5199b2b2.headline: A new approach to socialized housing
n8f5199b2b2.summary: The Philippine government launched the Pambansang Pabahay Para sa Pilipinas national housing program in 2022, aiming for zero informal settlers by 2028.
n8f5199b2b2.why: Government-backed housing programs drive demand for construction materials and developers and shape the country's property market.

n354ce08a6f.headline: B.C. Premier to meet with Mark Carney over the soaring lumber duties imposed by U.S.  | Globalnews.ca
n354ce08a6f.summary: B.C. Premier David Eby will meet Prime Minister Mark Carney on Monday to discuss the impact of Trump's tariffs and soaring lumber duties on Canada's forest industry.
n354ce08a6f.why: Lumber duties raise costs for Canadian producers exporting to the US, affecting forestry companies and homebuilding material prices.

n667da95c75.headline: SEC readies reforms to boost capital market
n667da95c75.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission is preparing reforms aimed at further unlocking the potential of the Philippines' capital market.
n667da95c75.why: The securities regulator oversees listings, trading and investor protection, so its reforms shape market depth and capital-raising conditions.
